task_title: Bow ranged goal-directed kiting + NPC-approach escape (#453)

plan_review.notes: Reviewer rejected generic goal-biased ENGAGE kiting: existing ENGAGE anti-stall/fallback pursuit can override it, raw point objectives lose identity, blended drift can dilute retreat, and all projectile families would inherit unproven behavior. Revised plan adopts refined Alt C at the NPC gate: projectile weapons stay in Progress/EXPLORE, preserving travel steering while state-independent auto-fire handles threats; add a reusable progress-aware no-progress valve for melee/geometry stalls. Generic ranged kite math and all non-NPC engagement callers remain unchanged.
